investigations.summary: PMM-T2030: the setup's only replica sbtest load is one 30 s sysbench burst, which fell outside the test's now-15m QAN window once the GR setup took 15 min; reproduced on a VM (main fails outside the window, the fix branch passes).
nightly / ha: pmm3-ha-eks #338 got HELM_CHART_BRANCH=main again and failed Install PMM HA on the vmauth.yaml b64dec error; the fix is Percona-Lab/jenkins-pipelines#4493, still open.
ha: PMM-T2233/PMM-T2144 leaderStatus still reads the left-menu leader that PMM-13860 removed; already covered by the open PR #1512.
compat / client 3.9.1: PMM-T1090 lost the Europe/London time zone after navigating via Inventory, which is PMM-15557; #1516 parks the test until that is fixed.

downloads.percona.com slowed to 136-770 KB/s between 04:40 and 05:30 under the nightly's own fan-out (176 MB client tarball in 15m57s, PS 5.7 package install 1029 s). That cancelled 12 CLI compatibility jobs at 40 min, and PMM-T2227 (tarball upgrade) hit its 120 s timeout in two Generic jobs. Diagnosed from logs only; pmm-framework downloads the tarball once per container. No fix yet.

pkg arm64 upgrade custom port (Debian 12 only): pmm-agent.yaml lacked 17788 330 ms after pmm-agent setup. Not reproduced on a VM: 0/30 with the playbook's own agent start, 0/60 with the real 3.9.1 deb and its systemd unit at 0, 9 and 12 CPU hogs.
